label: Much / many / a lot of
outcome: Lo studente sceglie much, many e a lot of collegando la scelta alla countability e al tipo di frase, usando how much/how many nelle domande, much/many nelle negative e a lot of come scelta quotidiana naturale con entrambi i tipi di nome.
must_master: a lot of with both countable plural and uncountable nouns
natural everyday affirmative use of a lot of

scope_boundary.few_little: Do not teach few/a few/little/a little; separate quantifier material.
scope_boundary.too_much_many: Do not make too much/too many a core target here.
scope_boundary.advanced_register: Acknowledge that affirmative much exists, but do not teach register/style exceptions systematically.
scope_boundary.countability: Use countability as prerequisite evidence rather than reteaching the full noun lesson.

italian_learner_risks.target: many people / a lot of people
much time / a lot of time

italian_learner_risks.risk: learning the false rule 'much is only negative'
italian_learner_risks.example_wrong: treating every affirmative much as grammatically impossible
italian_learner_risks.target: understand that a lot of is usually the everyday target in simple affirmatives

requirements: a lot of with both noun types

quality_rejections: teaching 'much only in negative/questions' as an absolute rule
making a lot of seem ungrammatical in questions/negatives rather than focusing on natural target use
advanced register distinctions that distract from school-level control
ambiguous quantity contexts with two equally natural answer choices when only one is accepted
